name: Cards
summary: Nine meaning cards for the AhaSlides marketing sites (Webflow Cards), built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius: Testimonial card, Case study card, Template card, Feature card, Step card, Statistic card, Article card, Integration card and Pricing card, plus a Steps row that lays three Step cards in one horizontal row. Framework-free HTML and CSS, bound to the shared --aha-* tokens. Each type has its own copyable snippet; linked types use one stretched link over the whole card. The feature sections built from the Feature card and its icon squares (alternating rows, an icon grid, an icon list with a photo, icon cards, a row of three Feature cards, icon cards with a side header, tabs with screenshots and five Compact layouts) sit right after the Feature card, each with a White / Accent switch.
highlights: Nine card types, each with its own paste-and-run snippet, and fourteen feature sections right after the Feature card, each with its own labelled preview and code
Built on the Card anatomy (cover, title, body, actions) with the marketing radius and marketing type scale; not the aha-card web component
Whole card is one link (stretched-link pattern) on Case study, Template, Feature, Article and Integration cards; Testimonial, Statistic and Step cards are static
Hover lift only on linked cards, a visible focus ring around the whole card, and no motion under reduced motion
16:9 template thumbnails, 3:2 case-study and article covers; neutral placeholders until a real image replaces the media block
Grid steps from three columns to two at 991px and to one at 767px; padding tightens at 479px

Pictures fill the media slot edge to edge at their own ratio (aha-marketing-card__media--fill) when a landscape or square image is alone or among others of the same size. A portrait image (taller than wide) is always framed, even alone or when every image is the same size, and so is a section with more than one image of different sizes: they sit uncropped in a Vivid Pink frame (aha-marketing-card__media--pink-frame) with the centre Splash behind them; a grid where readers compare the pictures adds aha-marketing-cards__grid--image-led: two columns at most, every image at least half the content width, one column below 768px

A how-it-works sequence is one horizontal row of three Step cards (aha-marketing-cards__grid--row), each with an optional 3:2 image below the text: three across, one column below 768px, no two-column step

Templates are a 3 by n grid on desktop: add aha-marketing-cards__grid--templates and pass a multiple of 3 Template cards; at 992px and wider it stays three columns (never the 2-column image-led layout, no 2 by 2 for four, no centred lone card), and the 768 to 991px and phone layouts are the Cards defaults

Feature sections keep their aha-features class names and base CSS, so a section already pasted on a live site still matches; Icon cards and the Feature card row reuse the Feature card above unchanged and add only the grid around it

Five Compact layouts (accordion beside one image, tabs over one screenshot, swipeable card scroller, pick-from-a-list, top three with See all features) that keep a Features section within one screen; 48 px section padding, no intro sentence under the title, closed content stays in the HTML
Tabs with screenshots ships working WAI-ARIA tabs (arrow keys, Home, End) in a short framework-free script; the structure maps onto Webflow's native Tabs element
Feature sections are container-query blocks: they step down at 991 px and 767 px and tighten again below 480 px, wherever they sit

layoutsIntro: Each feature section copies the layout of one Untitled UI features section, and nothing else of it; the five Compact layouts are the design system's own. Class names carry the layout, not the Untitled UI number.

guidance.title: Feature sections: choosing a background
guidance.intro: Every feature section below has a White / Accent switch in its preview and a tab for each in its code.

points.title: White is the default
points.text: Use White unless the section needs to stand apart from the white sections around it. It is today's look and needs no extra class.

points.title: Accent
points.text: Add aha-features--accent to the section. It lays the pale pink Accent background (bgAccent) over white, so it looks the same wherever it sits. The icon squares switch to white and keep their pink glyph; cards stay white with their pink icon tile, and image placeholders stay grey.

points.title: Neighbours
points.text: Never place an Accent section next to another coloured section. Put it between white sections.

points.title: Fill the slot, or frame mixed sizes
points.text: Never crop a screenshot. When the section holds one landscape or square image, or several of the same size, add aha-features__photo--fill to the photo slot: the image fills the slot edge to edge at its own ratio, with no frame and no inset. When an image is portrait (taller than wide), or the section holds more than one image and the images differ in size or ratio, add aha-features__photo--pink-frame to the photo slot, put the Splash icon in an aha-features__splash element behind it and give the picture the class aha-features__shot: each image is contained with an even inset on Vivid Pink (--aha-vivid-pink-100) with the centre Splash, and the frame keeps one ratio (4:3) for every row of the section.
